title: Grade 3 French — Mon, Jun 16
description: La maison — Day 1 of 5: Les pièces de la maison (rooms of the house)
subject: french

questions.question: "La maison" means:
questions.explanation: La maison = the house. Maison is a feminine noun in French.

questions.question: "La chambre" means:
questions.explanation: La chambre = the bedroom. It is a feminine noun.

questions.question: "La cuisine" means:
questions.explanation: La cuisine = the kitchen. It is where cooking is done.

questions.question: "Le salon" means:
questions.explanation: Le salon = the living room. Le = masculine article. It is where the family gathers.

questions.question: "La salle de bains" means:
questions.explanation: La salle de bains = the bathroom (literally 'the room of baths').

questions.question: "La salle à manger" means:
questions.explanation: La salle à manger = the dining room (literally 'the room for eating').

questions.question: "Le garage" means:
questions.explanation: Le garage = the garage. It is the same word in English!

questions.question: "Le jardin" means:
questions.explanation: Le jardin = the garden. French jardin → English 'garden' (same origin).

questions.question: Where do you sleep in French — "Je dors dans ___"?
questions.explanation: Je dors dans la chambre = I sleep in the bedroom. Dormir = to sleep.

questions.question: Where do you eat in French — "Je mange dans ___"?
questions.explanation: Je mange dans la salle à manger = I eat in the dining room.

questions.question: Where do you cook — "On cuisine dans ___"?
questions.explanation: On cuisine dans la cuisine = We cook in the kitchen.

questions.question: Which rooms use the article "le" (masculine)?
options: La chambre, la cuisine, la salle de bains
Le salon, le garage, le jardin
La maison, la salle à manger, le salon
Le chambre, le cuisine, le jardin
questions.explanation: Le salon, le garage, le jardin are all masculine. La chambre, la cuisine, la salle de bains are feminine.

questions.question: Complete: "Dans ma maison, il y a ___ salon, ___ cuisine et ___ chambre." (fill the articles)
questions.explanation: Un salon (masc.), une cuisine (fem.), une chambre (fem.). Indefinite articles un/une agree with gender.

questions.question: "L'escalier" means:
questions.explanation: L'escalier = the staircase. The article becomes l' before a vowel sound.

questions.question: How do you say 'I am in the kitchen' in French?
questions.explanation: Je suis dans la cuisine. La cuisine is feminine, so use la (definite article).
